note: Adapted from the species-level description by Mjöberg (1920); the original is in English. Soldier, worker and alate are all included, but the scanned text begins with the alate wing venation and ends with the worker antennae, so both ends are truncated; the measurements follow the alate and soldier text; figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body flattened, straw yellow; apex of mandibles and compound eyes black; head reddish brown. Head much longer than wide, widest at the compound eyes, slightly narrowing towards the base; sides rounded, posterior angles rounded; suture distinct; anterior part rugose. Compound eyes not protruding, wider than long. Labrum large, convex, covering the base of the mandibles, with a row of setae at the apex. Antennae arising from a notch on the anterior part of the head, 18-segmented; first two segments thick and long, segment 3 much shorter and smaller, segment 4 shortest, segments from 5 onwards gradually longer and thinner; base and apex paler, setose. Mandibles long and pointed: left mandible with two large, flat, leaf-like teeth and, immediately below tooth 2, a smaller rounded tooth; right mandible with a large flat tooth above the middle and a broad blunt tooth below. Pronotum wide, cordate; anterior margin slightly arched at the middle; sides setose, steeply sloping towards the anterior margin; disc with two distinct rounded depressions near the anterior margin and a median line; meso- and metathorax much wider, each with a lateral depression on either side. Legs short; femora very thick, tibiae thinner. Abdomen flat, shining, widest at the middle, apex of the last segment arched. Body length 12 mm; length of head with mandibles 5 mm; head width 2.13 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Straw yellow; only a chitinous patch near the compound eyes and the base of the antennae dark brown; head pale reddish brown. Head round, subcircular, shining, deeply concave between the compound eyes; labium large, convex, completely covering the mandibles, narrow at the base, wider and rounded at the apex, setose; mandibles short, irregularly triangular, straw yellow, dark brown on the inner half, with two distinct pointed teeth at the tip and, immediately below them, a more rectangular tooth, the inner margin of the base finely serrate; antennae (14) 15-segmented, basal segments with indistinct sutures and a tendency to divide, apical segments distinct, rounded on both sides, slightly longer than wide, setose, segments 1 and 2 slightly thicker.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Wings long and wide, rounded at the apex; hind wing wider but shorter than the fore wing. Costa and subcosta more or less reduced; radius unbranched, running from the base along the anterior margin through the basal quarter of the wing, then well developed and giving off about 9 transverse, more or less parallel veins towards the anterior wing margin; media running through the middle of the wing and giving off about 6–8 oblique, simple or branched veins; cubitus distinct, with 5–7 oblique veins; venation of the hind wing similar. Setae scattered around the wing margins; several fine cross-veins between the radial sector and the media form a shallow network in the membrane. Abdominal apex rounded; cerci well developed, indistinctly 4-segmented; styli apparently 1-segmented. Length with wings 15 mm; body length 7.5 mm.
